name: Men Wearing Earrings
overview: Scripture references earrings primarily as items of value and cultural significance, as seen when a man gave a golden earring to Rebekah (Genesis 24:22) and when Jacob's family surrendered their earrings along with idols (Genesis 35:4). Earrings were also used as offerings to the Lord by both men and women (Exodus 35:22). While earrings appear in various contexts, including the piercing of the ear to symbolize servitude (Exodus 21:6), the biblical narrative does not explicitly endorse or condemn men wearing earrings as a practice, but rather highlights their role in worship, covenant, and cultural customs.
